checked_sources.checked_excerpt: **PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. All PHP users are strongly encouraged to update immediately.**
checked_sources.scope: Stored documentary text only; no embedded page instructions followed.

checked_sources.checked_excerpt: PHP uses `longjmp()` for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. In some contexts, request memory is temporarily reachable before it is fully initialized. If any allocation fails at that point, PHP does not properly account for the early exit and leaves the request memory in an invalid state. The failed allocation does not need to be related to the invalid memory. The request shutdown procedure may then read or branch on it. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).
checked_sources.scope: Stored documentary text only; no embedded page instructions followed.

checked_sources.checked_excerpt: The confirmed impact is unauthenticated heap use-after-free, memory disclosure and remote code execution with the web worker's privileges. The fatal backtrace path has confirmed RCE against mod\_php. Session lifecycle RCE was validated against mod\_php and FPM. Other state families establish security impact only after a concrete producer and consumer are shown.
checked_sources.scope: Stored documentary text only; no embedded page instructions followed.

checked_sources.checked_excerpt: Amazon Threat Intelligence identified a PHP2Shell exploitation attempt dating to Oct. 17, 2026, in MadPot telemetry, four days before public disclosure of CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. The exploit attempt originated from an IP address associated with a commercial anonymization network. While the vulnerability was under embargo, the targeting of a honeypot from an anonymized IP address suggests the activity was conducted by a threat actor, though it remains unclear how the actor acquired exploit information prior to disclosure.
